comments.value:
So SDK panel should catch MissingComponentException for avatar animator and display a message as a blank SDK panel is confusing to users? 

For reference very similar thread:

https://ask.vrchat.com/t/having-trouble-with-build-and-publishing-an-avatar/15765

Looking at the thread again, they have the screenshots backwards. At first the animator missing is a warning, but then when the critical blocker is fixed, and now the animator missing stops the panel from being filled out.

details:
User (MadBen#7507) queried VRC Discord Avatar help (https://discord.com/channels/189511567539306508/730948173379535022/1099199598716797018) to remedy the following:

After selecting "auto-fix streaming mipmaps", SDK window goes blank. Manually configuring streaming mipmaps produces same result. Console errors follow:

MissingComponentException: There is no 'Animator' attached to the "Porco Jaw Titan" game object, but a script is trying to access it.

You probably need to add a Animator to the game object "Porco Jaw Titan". Or your script needs to check if the component is attached before using it.
